question_text:
Can: Would you like to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ece: ----
Can: That's a pity. Maybe next time.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_a: Sure, I'll be there at five.
option_c: I'd love to, but I'm visiting my grandparents.

question_text: Which of the following is used to apologize?
option_a: I'm sorry for breaking your pen.
option_d: How about going to the cinema?
explanation: “I'm sorry for …” kalıbı özür dilemek için kullanılır. Diğerleri teklif, kabul ve öneri bildirir.

question_text:
Read the message.
“Hi Mert! I'm having a picnic at the park on Sunday at 11 a.m. Everyone will bring some food. Can you bring some sandwiches? Let me know. — Defne”
What does Defne want Mert to do?
option_b: Come to her house at 11 a.m.
explanation: Defne mesajında Mert'ten pikniğe sandviç getirmesini istemektedir (“Can you bring some sandwiches?”).

question_text:
Four students describe a good friend:
Ali: A good friend keeps my secrets.
Beril: A good friend always tells lies to make me happy.
Cem: A good friend supports me when I am sad.
Dila: A good friend shares things with me.
Whose idea is NOT suitable for a good friend?
explanation: İyi bir arkadaş dürüst olmalıdır. Beril'in “her zaman yalan söyler” ifadesi iyi bir arkadaşın özelliğiyle bağdaşmaz.

question_text:
Eren: Hey Zeynep, we are going bowling after school. Do you want to join us?
Zeynep: I'd really like to, but I have a piano lesson at four. ----
Eren: Sure! See you there.
Which of the following best completes the dialogue?
option_c: Can I join you after my lesson?
explanation: Zeynep önce dersi olduğunu söylemiş, Eren de “Sure! See you there.” ile olumlu cevap vermiştir. Bu nedenle Zeynep'in dersten sonra katılmayı önerdiği seçenek uygundur.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“A trustworthy friend ---- your secrets.”
explanation: Güvenilir (trustworthy) bir arkadaş sırlarını saklar (keeps your secrets).

question_text:
Look at the chart showing what students do when a friend is upset.
ActionStudents
listen to him/her18
give advice12
make him/her laugh8
leave him/her alone2
Which of the following is TRUE according to the chart?
option_a: Most students listen to their upset friend.
option_b: More students leave their friend alone than give advice.
option_c: Making a friend laugh is the most popular action.
explanation: Tabloya göre en çok öğrenci (18) üzgün arkadaşını dinlemektedir.

question_text: Sena forgot her best friend's birthday. She feels very bad about it. What should she say to her friend?
option_b: Would you like to play tennis tomorrow?
option_d: I'm really sorry I forgot your birthday. Let me make it up to you.
explanation: Sena arkadaşının doğum gününü unuttuğu için özür dilemeli ve telafi etmeyi önermelidir.

question_text:
“Why don't we go to the cinema tonight?”
Which response ACCEPTS the invitation?
explanation: “That sounds fun!” daveti kabul eder; diğer cevaplar reddetme bildirir.

question_text:
Choose the correct option.
“I can't stand ---- in long queues.”
explanation: “Can't stand” fiilinden sonra fiil -ing almalıdır: “waiting”.

question_text:
The table shows how often Emir does some activities in a week.
ActivityDays a week
play basketball7
read books3
play video games1
go to the cinema0
Which of the following is TRUE?
option_b: Emir often goes to the cinema.
explanation: Haftanın 7 günü yapılan etkinlik “always” ile anlatılır; Emir her gün basketbol oynamaktadır. Sinemaya hiç gitmez (never).

question_text:
Read the text.
“My name is Lara. I'm fourteen. I'm keen on photography and I take photos of birds at weekends. I'm not fond of shopping. I prefer spending time in nature to staying at home.”
Which of the following is NOT true about Lara?
option_d: She prefers nature to staying at home.
explanation: Lara alışverişi sevmediğini (not fond of shopping) belirtmiştir; bu nedenle alışveriş yapmaktan hoşlandığı doğru değildir.

question_text: Which frequency adverb means “0%”?
explanation: “Never” hiçbir zaman (%0) anlamındadır.

question_text:
Four teenagers talk about their weekends:
Kaan: I usually hang out with my friends at the mall.
Leyla: I rarely watch TV; I prefer reading.
Mina: I always do my homework on Saturday mornings.
Nazlı: I sometimes go cycling with my dad.
Who does an activity EVERY weekend?
explanation: “Always” her zaman anlamına gelir; Mina ödevini her cumartesi sabahı yapmaktadır.

question_text:
“She prefers tea ---- coffee.”
Which word completes the sentence?
explanation: “Prefer A to B” kalıbında “to” kullanılır: She prefers tea to coffee.

question_text:
Arda: What do you do in your free time?
Berk: ----
Arda: Really? I'm keen on it, too.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_c: I'm fond of playing the guitar.
explanation: Arda boş zamanında ne yaptığını sormuş ve cevaba “Ben de buna meraklıyım.” demiştir. Bu nedenle bir hobi bildiren cevap uygundur.

question_text: Which kitchen verb means “to cook something in hot oil”?

question_text:

Which word completes the recipe?
explanation: Tarifte “First” ve “Then”den sonra, “Finally”den önce bir sıralama sözcüğü gerekir; “After that” uygundur.

question_text:
Making tea:
1. Boil some water.
2. Put the tea leaves into the teapot.
3. ----
4. Wait for ten minutes and serve.
Which step completes the instructions?
option_b: Pour the hot water into the teapot.
explanation: Su kaynatılıp çay yaprakları demliğe konduktan sonra sıcak su demliğe dökülmelidir.

question_text:
Choose the correct passive form.
“They mix the eggs and the flour.”
option_a: The eggs and the flour were mix.
option_b: The eggs and the flour are mixed.
option_c: The eggs and the flour is mixing.
option_d: The eggs and the flour mix.
explanation: Geniş zamanda edilgen yapı “am/is/are + V3” ile kurulur: “are mixed”.

question_text:
A recipe for pancakes:
“Mix two cups of flour, one egg and a cup of milk in a bowl. Heat a pan and add a little oil. Pour some of the mixture into the pan. Cook each side for two minutes.”
According to the recipe, which of the following is NOT necessary?
explanation: Tarifte un, yumurta, süt ve yağ kullanılmaktadır; şekerden söz edilmemiştir.

question_text:
“Could you ---- the carrots, please? I need them for the cake.”
Which verb best completes the sentence?
explanation: Havuçlu kekte havuç rendelenir: “grate the carrots”.

question_text:
Chef Kerem: First, we chop the onions. Next, we fry them for three minutes. Then, we add the tomatoes and cook for ten minutes.
What does the chef do right after chopping the onions?
explanation: Şef soğanları doğradıktan hemen sonra (Next) onları üç dakika kızartır.

question_text:
Look at the table about three dishes.
DishCooking timeMethod
Menemen15 minfry
Lentil soup40 minboil
Baked potatoes50 minbake

option_b: Lentil soup is quicker than menemen.
option_c: Menemen is baked in the oven.
option_d: Baked potatoes take the longest time to cook.

question_text: Which sentence is used to ask someone to wait on the phone?
explanation: “Hold on, please.” telefonda karşı tarafı beklemeye almak için kullanılır.

question_text:
Mrs. Aydın: Hello?
Ozan: Hello, this is Ozan. Can I speak to Burak, please?
Mrs. Aydın: Sorry, he isn't at home right now. ----
Ozan: Yes, please. Can you tell him to call me back?

option_b: Would you like to leave a message?
explanation: Ozan'ın “Yes, please. Can you tell him to call me back?” cevabı, kendisine mesaj bırakmak isteyip istemediğinin sorulduğunu gösterir.

question_text:
Read the phone message note.
“Message for: Elif · From: Coach Tarık · Message: Basketball practice is cancelled tomorrow. It will be on Friday at 5 p.m.”
Which of the following is TRUE?
option_a: The practice will be tomorrow at 5 p.m.
explanation: Nota göre yarınki antrenman iptal edilmiştir; antrenman cuma saat 17.00'de yapılacaktır.

question_text:
“I can't hear you very well. ----”
Which sentence completes the speech?
explanation: Karşı tarafı iyi duyamamak hattın kötü olmasıyla ilgilidir: “The line is bad.”

question_text:
Selin calls the dentist's office.
Receptionist: Good morning, Smile Dental Clinic. How can I help you?
Selin: ----
Receptionist: Let me check. We have an appointment on Tuesday at 3 p.m.

option_a: Can I speak to my teacher?
option_b: I'm calling to cancel my flight.
option_c: I'd like to make an appointment, please.
option_d: I'd like to order a pizza.
explanation: Resepsiyon görevlisinin randevu saatini söylemesi, Selin'in randevu almak istediğini gösterir.

question_text: Which question is asked to learn who the caller is?
explanation: “Who's calling, please?” arayan kişinin kim olduğunu öğrenmek için sorulur.

question_text:
Gizem: Hi Ali, are you free tonight?
Ali: Sorry, I'm going to help my mom with the cleaning. I'll call you back later, okay?
Gizem: OK, talk to you later.
What is Ali going to do tonight?
explanation: Ali bu akşam annesine temizlikte yardım edeceğini söylemiştir.

question_text:

Belgin: My phone's battery died in the middle of the call.
Can: I dialled the wrong number by mistake.
Deniz: There was a lot of noise and the voice was breaking up.

explanation: Ahmet'in aradığı kişi başka biriyle konuştuğu için hat meşguldür (the line was busy).

• Don't share personal information.
• Think before you post.
• Tell an adult if someone bothers you.
• Log out after using public computers.

option_c: Telling an adult about bothering messages
explanation: İpuçlarında şifreyi her gün değiştirmekten söz edilmemektedir.

question_text: Which word means “bullying someone online”?
explanation: İnternet üzerinden zorbalık yapmaya “cyberbullying” denir.

Kemal: I spend six hours a day online. I can't sleep well and I feel tired at school.
Which advice is the most suitable for Kemal?
option_a: You should buy a new phone.
option_b: You should limit your screen time.
option_c: You should play more online games.
explanation: Kemal'in sorunu internette çok fazla zaman geçirmesidir; ekran süresini sınırlaması önerilmelidir.

Mert: ----

option_a: I'd rather not. I have a lot of homework.
option_d: Sure, let's call her at eight.

question_text:
Choose the correct option.
“Skydiving is ---- than canoeing.”
explanation: İki şey karşılaştırılırken comparative yapı kullanılır: “more dangerous than”.

option_a: Rafting is more expensive than paragliding.

question_text:
Melis: Would you like to go rock climbing this weekend?
Onur: ---- It's too dangerous for me.

explanation: Onur kaya tırmanışının kendisi için çok tehlikeli olduğunu söylemiştir; başka bir etkinliği tercih ettiğini bildiren “I'd rather go hiking.” uygundur.

question_text: Which is the superlative form of “good”?
explanation: “Good” düzensiz bir sıfattır: good → better → the best.

question_text:
Four friends describe their adventure experiences:
Ayla: Scuba diving was amazing; I saw colourful fish under the sea.
Bora: Bungee jumping was the scariest thing I've ever done.
Ceren: Camping in the forest was relaxing.
Doruk: Paragliding gave me the best view of the city.
Who did an underwater activity?
explanation: Tüplü dalış (scuba diving) su altında yapılan bir etkinliktir; Ayla deniz altında balıklar görmüştür.

question_text: “Mount Ağrı is ---- mountain in Türkiye.”
explanation: Bir şeyin bir grup içinde en yüksek olduğu anlatılırken superlative kullanılır: “the highest”.

Bungee jumpingdangerouscheap

question_text:
“I'd rather stay at a hotel than camp in a tent.”

option_a: He/She prefers staying at a hotel.
option_c: He/She has never been to a hotel.
option_d: He/She loves camping in a tent.
explanation: “I'd rather A than B” kalıbı A'yı tercih ettiğini gösterir; konuşan otelde kalmayı tercih etmektedir.

question_text:

explanation: “Ever” ile deneyim sorulurken Present Perfect kullanılır: “Have you ever been …?”

“Last summer, we visited Cappadocia. We took a hot-air balloon tour at sunrise. The view of the fairy chimneys was breathtaking. We also bought some pottery as souvenirs.”
Which of the following is NOT mentioned in the text?
explanation: Metinde balon turu, peribacaları ve hediyelik çömlekten söz edilmiştir; kaldıkları otelden bahsedilmemiştir.

question_text:
Tourist: Excuse me, how can I get to the museum?
Local: ----
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_d: Go straight and turn left at the bank.
explanation: Turist müzeye nasıl gidileceğini sormaktadır; yol tarifi veren cevap uygundur.

question_text: Which word means “a small object you buy to remember a place”?
explanation: Bir yeri hatırlamak için alınan küçük eşyaya “souvenir” (hediyelik eşya) denir.

explanation: Kayak merkezleriyle ünlü şehir Erzurum'dur ve en uygun ziyaret zamanı kıştır.

question_text: “I have ---- visited Ephesus. It was amazing!”
explanation: Olumlu Present Perfect cümlelerinde “zaten, çoktan” anlamında “already” kullanılır.

question_text:
A travel agent: “This hotel is next to the beach. It has a swimming pool and a kids' club. Breakfast is free, but you have to pay for dinner.”
Which of the following is TRUE about the hotel?
option_d: It is far from the beach.
explanation: Kahvaltı ücretsizdir (free); akşam yemeği ücretlidir ve otel plajın yanındadır.

question_text:
Can: Have you ever tried Turkish delight?
Anna: ----
Can: You should! It's delicious.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_c: Yes, I have. I love it.
explanation: Can'ın “You should!” (Denemelisin!) cevabı, Anna'nın lokumu daha önce hiç denemediğini gösterir.

question_text:
“You ---- touch the hot stove. It's dangerous!”
Which modal completes the sentence?
explanation: Yasak bildirmek için “mustn't” kullanılır.

ChoreEceBrotherMomDad
do the laundry✓
take out the rubbish✓
water the plants✓
vacuum the carpet✓

explanation: Zorunlu olmadığını bildirmek için “don't have to” kullanılır.

question_text: Which chore is done in the kitchen after a meal?
explanation: Yemekten sonra masayı toplamak (clear the table) mutfakta yapılan bir iştir.

question_text:
Mom: Kerem, your room is a mess! ----
Kerem: OK, Mom. I'll do it after lunch.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_c: You don't have to clean it.
option_d: You have to tidy it up.
explanation: Anne odanın dağınık olduğunu söylemiş, Kerem de öğle yemeğinden sonra yapacağını belirtmiştir. Odayı toplaması gerektiğini bildiren cümle uygundur.

question_text:

Buse: I love cooking, so I help my mom in the kitchen.
Can: I hate ironing, but I have to do it every week.
Duru: I don't mind dusting the furniture.
Ege: I can't stand doing the dishes.

explanation: Can ütü yapmaktan nefret ettiğini ama her hafta yapmak zorunda olduğunu söylemiştir.

question_text:
Rules of a summer camp:
• You must make your bed every morning.
• You mustn't use your phone after 10 p.m.
• You don't have to join the morning run.
Which of the following is TRUE according to the rules?
option_a: Campers can use their phones at midnight.
option_b: Joining the morning run is optional.
option_c: Campers mustn't join the morning run.
option_d: Making the bed is not necessary.

question_text:
Read Selin's weekly plan.
DayChore
Mondayfeed the fish
Wednesdaytake out the rubbish
Saturdayvacuum the carpet
What does Selin have to do on Wednesday?
explanation: Plana göre Selin çarşamba günü çöpü çıkarmak zorundadır.

question_text: Which chore is done with an iron?
explanation: Ütü (iron) ile yapılan iş giysileri ütülemektir.

Experiment: I put one plant near the window and another in a dark cupboard.

option_a: The plant near the window died.

explanation: Deney sonucunda karanlık dolaptaki bitki sararmıştır; bu, hipotezi destekler.

explanation: Bilim insanları deneylerini genellikle laboratuvarda yapar.

Which of the following is TRUE?
option_a: He studied how cells repair DNA.
option_c: He won the Nobel Prize in Physics.
explanation: Metne göre Aziz Sancar, hücrelerin hasarlı DNA'yı nasıl onardığını araştırmış ve 2015'te Nobel Kimya Ödülü'nü kazanmıştır.

II. Make a hypothesis
III. Write the conclusion
IV. Observe a problem
explanation: Bilimsel süreçte önce bir problem gözlemlenir, sonra hipotez kurulur, deney yapılır ve sonuç yazılır.

question_text: Which word means “a new thing that is created for the first time”?
explanation: İlk kez yapılan yeni bir şeye “invention” (icat) denir.

question_text:
The timeline shows some important inventions.
1876 → telephone
1903 → first powered aeroplane flight
1928 → penicillin was discovered
1969 → humans landed on the Moon
Which of the following is TRUE according to the timeline?
option_a: The aeroplane flew before the telephone was invented.
option_b: The telephone was invented after the aeroplane.
option_c: Penicillin was discovered before humans landed on the Moon.
option_d: Humans landed on the Moon in 1928.
explanation: Penisilin 1928'de keşfedilmiş, Ay'a iniş 1969'da gerçekleşmiştir; penisilin daha öncedir.

question_text:
Teacher: Scientists ---- a new planet outside our solar system recently.
Which of the following completes the sentence?
explanation: “Recently” (son zamanlarda) ile yakın geçmişte gerçekleşen bir olay Present Perfect ile anlatılır: “have discovered”.

question_text:
Four students talk about technology:
Ali: Smartphones have made communication easier.
Beyza: Robots are used in hospitals for surgery.
Cem: Electric cars were invented to reduce air pollution.
Deniz: I think science is boring.
Who expresses a personal opinion rather than a fact?
explanation: Deniz'in “I think science is boring.” sözü kişisel bir görüştür; diğerleri bilgi bildirir.

question_text: What should you do during an earthquake?
explanation: Deprem sırasında “çök, kapan, tutun” (drop, cover and hold on) yapılmalıdır.

question_text:
“If people cut down more trees, there ---- more floods and landslides.”
Which of the following completes the sentence?
explanation: Gelecekle ilgili koşul–sonuç bildiren cümlelerde sonuç kısmında “will” kullanılır.

question_text:
Look at the emergency kit list.
• water bottles
• a torch
• a first-aid kit
• a whistle
• ----
Which item is the most suitable to complete the list?
explanation: Acil durum çantasında hayati önemi olan malzemeler bulunur; battaniye bu listeye en uygun olanıdır.

question_text: Which natural disaster happens when there is no rain for a long time?
explanation: Uzun süre yağmur yağmamasına bağlı afet kuraklıktır (drought).

question_text:
Read the news.
“Heavy rain caused a flood in the city yesterday. Many streets were under water, so schools were closed. Experts say the flood happened because the drains were blocked with rubbish.”
What was the main cause of the flood according to experts?
option_b: The drains were blocked with rubbish.
explanation: Uzmanlara göre selin nedeni kanalizasyonların çöple tıkanmasıdır.

question_text: “Scientists predict that the temperature ---- in the next fifty years.”
explanation: Gelecekle ilgili tahmin “will” ile ifade edilir.

question_text:
The table shows some natural disasters and safety tips.
DisasterSafety tip
WildfireLeave the area quickly.
EarthquakeDrop, cover and hold on.
FloodGo down to the basement.
Which safety tip in the table is WRONG?
explanation: Sel sırasında bodruma inmek tehlikelidir; yüksek bir yere çıkılmalıdır. Bu nedenle sel için verilen ipucu yanlıştır.

question_text:
Mert: We should use less plastic. ----
Which sentence gives a reason for Mert's idea?
option_c: I bought a new bag yesterday.
option_d: It pollutes the oceans and harms animals.
explanation: Plastiğin okyanusları kirletmesi ve hayvanlara zarar vermesi, daha az plastik kullanılması gerektiğinin nedenidir.

question_text: Which of the following is used to accept an invitation?
explanation: “Sure, I'd love to come.” daveti kabul etmek için kullanılır. Diğer üçü daveti nazikçe reddetme ifadeleridir.

question_text:
Kaan: I'm organizing a movie night at my house on Friday. Would you like to come?
Selin: ----
Kaan: Great! It starts at seven.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_a: No, thanks. I don't like movies.
option_c: Of course! What time does it start?
option_d: Sorry, I have a lot of homework.
explanation: Kaan'ın “Great! It starts at seven.” cevabı, Selin'in daveti kabul edip saati sorduğunu gösterir.

question_text:
Read the text.
“My best friend is Arda. We have known each other since kindergarten. He is very generous; he always shares his snacks with me. He is also a bit stubborn, so it is hard to change his mind.”
Which of the following is NOT true about Arda?
option_a: He changes his mind very easily.
option_b: He has been the writer's friend for a long time.
explanation: Metinde Arda'nın inatçı olduğu ve fikrini değiştirmenin zor olduğu söylenmiştir (stubborn). Bu yüzden fikrini kolayca değiştirdiği yargısı yanlıştır.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“Elif is very ----. She always tells the truth.”
explanation: Her zaman doğruyu söyleyen kişi dürüsttür (honest).

question_text:
Look at the survey results about the most important quality in a friend.
QualityNumber of students
being supportive15
being funny9
being honest21
being generous5
According to the survey, which quality is the most important for the students?
explanation: Ankette en çok öğrenci (21) dürüstlüğü (being honest) en önemli özellik olarak seçmiştir.

question_text:
Defne: I had an argument with Ece yesterday, and now she isn't talking to me.
Mert: ----
Defne: You're right. I'll call her tonight.
Which of the following best completes the dialogue?
option_a: Why don't you call her and apologize?
option_b: Let's go to the cinema without her.
option_c: You should never talk to her again.
option_d: I don't like Ece at all.
explanation: Defne'nin “You're right. I'll call her tonight.” cevabı, Mert'in onu arayıp özür dilemesini önerdiğini gösterir.

question_text: Which of the following is used to refuse an invitation politely?
option_c: Yes, I'd be happy to join you.
option_d: Thanks for asking, but I have other plans.
explanation: “Thanks for asking, but I have other plans.” daveti kibarca reddetme ifadesidir; diğerleri daveti kabul eder.

question_text:
Read the invitation card.
“Dear friends, I'm turning fourteen! Join me for a pizza party at Funland on 12th May, from 2 p.m. to 5 p.m. Please reply by 8th May. — Can”
Which question CANNOT be answered according to the card?
option_b: What kind of present does Can want?
explanation: Kartta partinin yeri, Can'ın yaşı ve cevap için son tarih verilmiştir; ancak Can'ın nasıl bir hediye istediğine dair bilgi yoktur.

question_text:
Zehra wants to tell her friend that she misses her because her friend moved to another city.
Which of the following should she write in her message?
option_b: Can you lend me your notebook?
option_c: I really miss you. I hope we can meet soon.
option_d: I'm sorry, I'm busy this weekend.
explanation: Zehra arkadaşını özlediğini ifade etmek istemektedir; “I really miss you.” bu duyguyu doğrudan anlatır.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“I ---- watching documentaries. They are so informative.”
explanation: Belgeselleri bilgilendirici bulan kişi onları izlemekten hoşlanır (enjoy). Diğer seçenekler olumsuz duygular bildirir.

question_text:
Look at the table about Burak's weekly routine.
ActivityHow often
play basketballthree times a week
visit grandparentsonce a week
go to the cinemaonce a month
read a bookevery day
Which of the following is TRUE according to the table?
option_a: Burak reads a book every day.
option_c: Burak visits his grandparents three times a week.
option_d: Burak goes to the cinema every week.
explanation: Tabloya göre Burak her gün kitap okumaktadır. Sinemaya ayda bir gider, basketbolu haftada üç kez oynar, büyükanne ve büyükbabasını haftada bir ziyaret eder.

question_text:
Read the text.
“Hi, I'm Melis. On weekdays, I get up at seven and go to school. After school, I usually do my homework and then I chat with my friends online. At weekends, I sometimes go hiking with my family.”
What does Melis usually do after school?
explanation: Melis okuldan sonra genellikle ödevlerini yaptığını söylemektedir (“After school, I usually do my homework”).

question_text: Which of the following expresses dislike?
explanation: “can't stand” bir şeye katlanamamayı, yani hoşlanmamayı ifade eder. Diğer ifadeler hoşlanmayı bildirir.

question_text:
Four teenagers talk about their free time:
Onur: I prefer staying at home and playing chess.
Nil: I'm crazy about outdoor sports like cycling.
Tolga: I usually spend my free time in the library.
Su: I love making cakes in the kitchen.
Who prefers outdoor activities?
explanation: Nil bisiklet gibi açık hava sporlarına bayıldığını söylemektedir (outdoor sports). Diğerleri kapalı alan etkinliklerini tercih eder.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the dialogue.
Ayla: How often do you go swimming?
Emre: ----
explanation: “How often” sıklık sorar; “Twice a week.” (haftada iki kez) uygun cevaptır. Diğerleri yer, kişi ve neden bildirir.

question_text:

“First, ---- the potatoes into small pieces.”
explanation: Patatesleri küçük parçalara ayırmak için doğrayın (chop) fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the recipe for a fruit salad.
“First, wash the fruits. Then, peel the bananas and oranges. Next, slice all the fruits. After that, put them in a bowl and add some honey. Finally, mix and serve.”
What should you do just before putting the fruits in a bowl?
explanation: Tarifte meyveleri kaseye koymadan hemen önceki adım dilimlemektir (“Next, slice all the fruits. After that, put them in a bowl”).

question_text: Which of the following words is NOT related to cooking?
explanation: Fry (kızartmak), stir (karıştırmak) ve grate (rendelemek) yemek yapmakla ilgilidir. Vacuum (elektrik süpürgesiyle temizlemek) bir ev işidir.

question_text:
Look at the ingredients list.
Pancakes (for 4 people)
flour2 cups
milk1 cup
eggs2
sugar1 spoon
Ayşe wants to make pancakes for 8 people. How many eggs does she need?
explanation: Tarif 4 kişiliktir ve 2 yumurta gerekir. 8 kişi için malzemeler iki katına çıkar: 4 yumurta.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“Bake the cake in the ---- for 40 minutes.”
explanation: Kek fırında (oven) pişirilir.

question_text:
Chef: Our soup is ready, but it tastes a bit bland.
Assistant: ----
Chef: Good idea! Pass me the salt and pepper, please.
Which of the following best completes the dialogue?
option_a: Let's put it in the fridge.
option_b: Why don't we add some spices?
explanation: Şefin tuz ve biber istemesi, yardımcısının çorbaya baharat eklemeyi önerdiğini gösterir. “Bland” tatsız anlamına gelir.

question_text:
Read what four people say about Turkish food.
Neşe: Baklava is my favourite. It's very sweet.
Umut: I love menemen. It's a great breakfast dish.
Lale: Mantı is delicious but it takes a long time to prepare.
Ozan: I don't eat lahmacun because it's too spicy for me.
Whose comment includes a negative point about the preparation of a dish?
explanation: Lale, mantının lezzetli olduğunu ama hazırlanmasının uzun sürdüğünü söylemiştir. Ozan'ın yorumu hazırlıkla değil, acılıkla ilgilidir.

question_text:
Look at the steps for making tea.
I. Pour the boiling water into the teapot.
II. Boil some water in the kettle.
III. Put the tea leaves into the teapot.
IV. Wait for about 10 minutes and serve.
What is the correct order of the steps?
explanation: Önce su kaynatılır, sonra çay demliğe konur, ardından kaynar su dökülür ve demlenmesi beklenip servis edilir: II – III – I – IV.

question_text: Which of the following is used to ask to speak to someone on the phone?
option_c: Can I speak to Mr. Yılmaz, please?
explanation: “Can I speak to …, please?” telefonda biriyle görüşmek istemek için kullanılır.

question_text:
Receptionist: Good morning, Star Dental Clinic. How can I help you?
Mr. Demir: ----
Receptionist: Let me check. Is Thursday at 3 p.m. OK for you?

option_a: Can I leave a message for my wife?
option_b: I'd like to make an appointment with the dentist.
option_c: I'm calling to complain about my phone bill.
option_d: I'd like to order a pizza.
explanation: Resepsiyonistin uygun gün ve saat önermesi, Bay Demir'in diş hekiminden randevu istediğini gösterir.

question_text:

“Phone message — To: Melike. From: Hakan. Message: The football match is cancelled because of the rain. Please call me back. Time: 4:15 p.m.”
Which of the following is TRUE according to the message?
option_b: The match is cancelled because of the snow.
option_d: Hakan wants Melike to call him back.
explanation: Mesajda Hakan'ın Melike'den kendisini geri aramasını istediği yazmaktadır. Maç kar değil yağmur nedeniyle iptal edilmiştir.

question_text:

explanation: “I'll get her.” (Onu çağırıyorum.) ifadesi, B'nin karşı tarafı bekletip Derya'yı çağıracağını gösterir: “Just a moment, please.”

question_text:

option_a: I'm sorry, I must have the wrong number.

option_d: Please tell her to call me back.
explanation: Telefondaki kişinin Nilay olmaması ve “No problem.” cevabı, Ahmet'in yanlış numarayı aradığı için özür dilediğini gösterir.

question_text: What does “hang up” mean in a phone conversation?
explanation: “Hang up” telefonu kapatmak, yani görüşmeyi sonlandırmak demektir.

question_text:

question_text:
Seda: Hi, can I talk to Mr. Aksoy, please?

explanation: Sekreterin telefon numarasını sorması, Seda'nın Bay Aksoy'un kendisini geri aramasını rica ettiğini gösterir.

question_text:

“You should never share your ---- with anyone. Keep it secret.”
explanation: Şifre (password) kimseyle paylaşılmamalı ve gizli tutulmalıdır.

question_text:

“• Don't accept friend requests from strangers.
• Don't click on links from unknown e-mails.

explanation: İpuçlarına göre çevrim içi rahatsız edildiğinde bir yetişkine haber vermek güvenli bir davranıştır.

question_text: Which word means “to send a file from your computer to a website”?
explanation: Bilgisayardaki bir dosyayı bir web sitesine göndermek “upload” (yüklemek) ile ifade edilir. Download indirmek, log out oturumu kapatmak, delete silmek demektir.

question_text:
Four students talk about the Internet:
Ceren: I use online dictionaries to learn new words.
Bora: I share my home address on social media.
Pelin: I check the information on different websites.
Taner: I log out after using a public computer.
Whose behaviour is risky?
explanation: Ev adresini sosyal medyada paylaşmak kişisel bilgileri yabancılara açar; bu riskli bir davranıştır.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“I ---- for information about volcanoes on a search engine.”
explanation: Arama motorunda bilgi aramak “search for” kalıbıyla ifade edilir.

question_text:
Read the e-mail.
“Dear Ms. Kaya, I'm writing to send my science project. I attached the file to this e-mail. Please let me know if you can't open it. Best wishes, Emir”
Why did Emir write the e-mail?
option_a: To send his project to his teacher
option_b: To invite his teacher to a party
option_c: To ask for a new project topic
explanation: Emir e-postayı fen projesini göndermek için yazmıştır ve dosyayı e-postaya eklediğini belirtmiştir.

question_text:
Mert: I spend about six hours online every day, and I can't sleep well at night.
Doctor: ----
Which of the following is the best advice from the doctor?
option_a: You should sleep with your phone.
option_b: You should buy a faster computer.
option_c: You should spend more time online.
option_d: You should limit your screen time, especially before bed.
explanation: Uzun süre ekran başında kalmak uyku sorunlarına yol açabilir. Doktorun en uygun tavsiyesi ekran süresini, özellikle yatmadan önce, sınırlamaktır.

question_text: Which of the following is an extreme sport?
explanation: Bungee jumping yüksek risk ve heyecan içeren bir ekstrem spordur.

question_text:
Read the text.
“Last summer, I tried rafting for the first time. At first, I was really nervous because the river was fast. However, our guide was very experienced, and in the end it was the most exciting day of my life.”
How did the writer feel at the beginning?
explanation: Yazar başlangıçta nehir hızlı olduğu için çok gergin olduğunu söylemektedir (“I was really nervous”).

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“Climbing a high mountain is ---- than walking in a park.”
explanation: İki şey karşılaştırılırken uzun sıfatlarda “more … than” kullanılır: more difficult than.

question_text:
Ozan: Do you want to try paragliding with me this weekend?
Esra: No way! ----
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_d: I've always wanted to try it.
explanation: “No way!” (Asla!) teklifin reddedildiğini gösterir. Reddin gerekçesi olarak yükseklik korkusu uygundur.

question_text: Choose the word that has a similar meaning to “thrilling”.
explanation: “Thrilling” heyecan verici anlamındadır ve “exciting” ile eş anlamlıdır.

question_text:
Four people describe their preferences:
Anıl: I prefer safe activities like hiking.
Gül: I'd rather go scuba diving than visit a museum.
Serkan: I don't like water sports at all.
Yeşim: I prefer reading a book at home to going camping.
Who prefers an underwater activity?
explanation: Gül müze gezmek yerine tüplü dalışı (scuba diving) tercih ettiğini söylemektedir; bu bir su altı etkinliğidir.

question_text:
Read the advertisement.
“Adventure Camp! Hiking, camping and rock climbing for teens aged 12–16. Professional guides. All equipment provided. Book before 1st June and get 10% off!”
Which of the following is TRUE according to the advertisement?
option_a: There aren't any guides at the camp.
option_c: Campers don't need to bring their own equipment.
option_d: The camp is for children under 10.
explanation: İlanda tüm ekipmanın sağlandığı belirtilmiştir (All equipment provided); bu yüzden katılımcıların kendi ekipmanlarını getirmesi gerekmez.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“I have ---- been to Cappadocia. It was amazing!”
explanation: Olumlu cümlede “daha önce yaptım” anlamı için “already” kullanılır; “It was amazing!” oraya gidildiğini gösterir.

question_text:
Read the postcard.

What is Burcu going to do tomorrow?

option_a: Can I see the dessert menu?
option_b: Please bring me two slices of cake
explanation: 'I'm really full' (Çok tokum) diyen müşteri başka bir şey yiyemeyeceğini belirtir.

question_text: Which kitchen tool do you need to ---- potatoes into thin slices?
explanation: Patatesi ince dilimlere ayırmak için 'slice' (dilimlemek) fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Secretary: Good morning, ABC Tech. How can I help you?
Mr. Kaya: May I speak to Mrs. Demir, please?
Secretary: ----. I'll put you through to her office.
explanation: 'I'll put you through' (Sizi bağlıyorum) ifadesinden önce 'Hold on a moment, please' (Bir dakika bekleyin lütfen) denir.

question_text:
Elif: Hello, is Can there?
Can's mother: Sorry, he went out 10 minutes ago. ----?
Elif: Yes, please tell him to call me back when he returns.
option_c: Would you like to leave a message
explanation: Aranan kişi yoksa 'Would you like to leave a message?' (Mesaj bırakmak ister misiniz?) diye sorulur.

question_text: I prefer sending text messages to making phone calls because texting is quicker and I can ---- at any time.
explanation: Mesajlara her zaman yanıt verilebileceği için 'reply' (cevaplamak) uygundur.

question_text:
Read the internet safety rules:
1. Never share your passwords with strangers.
2. Avoid clicking on unknown links or pop-up ads.
3. Always ask your parents before downloading new files.
Which of the following follows these rules?
option_a: Bora uses strong passwords and never shares them online.
option_b: Ece sends her home address to people she met in a chat room.
option_c: Deniz clicks every pop-up advertisement to win free gifts.
option_d: Mert uses '123456' as his password on all websites.
explanation: Güçlü parola kullanmak ve bunları paylaşmamak internet güvenliği kurallarına uygundur.

question_text:
Teacher: Why do you use the Internet mostly, Zeynep?
Zeynep: I usually use it for ----. I read online articles and watch science videos for my school projects.
explanation: Makale okuyup bilim videoları izlemek ödev/proje için araştırma yapmak ('doing research') kapsamındadır.

question_text: If you want to send your homework file to your teacher via e-mail, you should click the ---- icon first.
explanation: E-postaya dosya eklemek için 'attachment' (ek/ataç) simgesi kullanılır.

question_text:
Look at the table of extreme sports:
• Skydiving: Very dangerous, exciting
• Trekking: Safe, relaxing
• Rafting: Challenging, wet
Ege says: 'I hate risky activities. I prefer being in nature and walking quietly.'
Which sport is the BEST for Ege?
explanation: Riskten hoşlanmayan ve doğada yürümeyi seven Ege için 'Trekking' (doğa yürüyüşü) en uygun seçenektir.

question_text:
Cem: Have you ever tried paragliding?
Onur: Yes, I tried it last summer in Fethiye. ----! You feel like a bird in the sky.
explanation: 'Gökyüzünde kuş gibi hissediyorsun' cümlesi deneyimin büyüleyici ('fascinating') olduğunu gösterir.

question_text: Before going rock climbing, you must wear a ---- to protect your head and use strong ropes.
explanation: Başı korumak için 'helmet' (kask) takılır.

question_text:
Read the short travel blog:
'Last summer I visited Cappadocia. I stayed in a cave hotel, took a hot-air balloon ride at sunrise, and tasted traditional pottery kebab. The fairy chimneys looked amazing!'
What did the writer NOT mention in the blog?
explanation: Konaklama (cave hotel), yerel yemek (pottery kebab) ve turistik yerler (fairy chimneys) geçiyor; ancak Kapadokya'ya nasıl ulaştığı (transportation) belirtilmemiş.

question_text:
Aylin: What is the ---- like in Antalya in July?
Buse: It is usually hot and sunny, around 35°C.
explanation: Sıcak ve güneşli (35°C) yanıtı hava durumunu ('weather') soran soruya verilir.

question_text: I prefer visiting ---- places such as ancient theaters and castles because I love learning about history.
explanation: Antik tiyatro ve kaleler tarihî ('historic') yerlerdir.

question_text:
Look at the family chore list:
• Mother: Cooking dinner
• Father: Taking out the garbage
• Ali: Vacuuming the carpets
• Eda: Watering the plants
Which of the following is FALSE according to the list?
option_a: Ali is responsible for cleaning the carpets.
option_b: The father prepares the evening meal.
option_c: Eda has to take care of the plants.
explanation: Akşam yemeğini pişiren annedir; baba çöpleri çıkarmakla sorumludur, bu yüzden babanın akşam yemeğini hazırladığı ifadesi yanlıştır.

question_text: In a shared house, everyone must ---- the chores equally so that no one gets too tired.
explanation: Ev işlerini eşit paylaşmak ('share the chores') sorumluluk bilincinin gereğidir.

question_text:
Library Rules:
• Keep quiet.
• Return books on time.
• Don't eat or drink inside.
Which rule is NOT related to the library?
option_a: Do not disturb others while they are reading.
option_b: Bring borrowed books back before the deadline.
option_c: Avoid bringing snacks into the reading room.
option_d: Feed the animals in the garden.
explanation: Bahçedeki hayvanları beslemek kütüphane kuralları arasında yer almaz.

question_text:
Aziz Sancar is a world-famous Turkish scientist. He won the 2015 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for his studies on how cells repair damaged DNA.
According to the text, Aziz Sancar ----.
option_a: received an international award in chemistry
explanation: 2015 Nobel Kimya Ödülü uluslararası bir kimya ödülüdür.

question_text: Scientists are currently ---- a new vaccine in the laboratory to protect people from seasonal viruses.
explanation: Laboratuvarda yeni bir aşı geliştirmek 'developing a new vaccine' ifadesiyle anlatılır.

question_text: Which of the following is an INVENTION rather than a scientific discovery?
explanation: Matbaa (printing press) insan tarafından yapılmış bir icattır (invention); diğerleri doğada zaten var olan şeylerin keşfidir (discovery).

question_text:
A severe ---- hit the coastal town yesterday. Heavy rain caused the river to overflow, and water covered the streets and first floors of houses.
Which natural disaster is described in the text?
explanation: Şiddetli yağmur sonucu nehrin taşması ve sokakların su altında kalması 'flood' (sel) felaketidir.

question_text: To prevent ---- and save our forests, people should never leave glass bottles in picnic areas or light uncontrolled fires.
explanation: Cam şişe bırakmamak ve kontrolsüz ateş yakmamak orman yangınlarını ('forest fires') önler.

question_text: What should we do to reduce global warming?
option_a: Cut down more trees in the Amazon
option_b: Use renewable energy sources like solar and wind power
option_c: Use private cars for short distances
option_d: Waste water and electricity at home
explanation: Güneş ve rüzgâr gibi yenilenebilir enerji kaynaklarını kullanmak küresel ısınmayı azaltır.
